summary: BCE Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of a voluntary conversion between its Series AI and Series AJ preferred shares. Approximately 1,875 Series AI shares were tendered for conversion into Series AJ, while 1,976,448 Series AJ shares were tendered or automatically converted into Series AI due to falling below the 2,000,000 share threshold. The conversion is a routine capital structure adjustment with no premium, acquisition, or strategic event. No price, advisor, or board recommendation is provided. This is a standard preferred share conversion, not a special situation.
